title: Two-time flow-map interval Mirror code
hypothesis: A shared flow-map MLP addressed by start-time plus duration will improve held-out map/composition quality per serialized byte or compute over native (start,end) conditioning and an ordinary coordinate control.
scope: Analytic low-dimensional ODE mechanism screen only; not PA260 image-model reproduction, CIFAR/ImageNet FID, or a generative capacity claim.

development.used_for: smoke check only; no hyperparameter selection

conditions: Mirror coordinate m=(s,dt=t-s) into same shared MLP
independent full map per sampled interval upper reference (analytic oracle only)
storage_authority: actual inference state dict serialization bytes; include all learned coordinate state

gates.useful_signal: Mirror improves fresh mean map and composition error >=10% at <=5% more serialized bytes and <=10% more MACs
gates.fail: Mirror does not improve either quality metric over native and coordinate alias within seed variance, or breaches budget
gates.not_established: unstable/missing fresh world or implementation issue

limitations: Mirror coordinate is a fixed invertible reparameterization of native times and is deliberately tested as the cheapest control.
No image data, FID, PA260 release checkpoint, or neural generative baseline is evaluated.
